description: External / stub-only cluster (IMAGE / PY / RTD / STOCKHISTORY / WEBSERVICE / COPILOT / DETECTLANGUAGE / TRANSLATE / ARRAYTOTEXT / FILTERXML / INFO / CUBE×7 / GETPIVOTDATA / PHONETIC). Every member dispatches to an external service or out-of-band workbook metadata that Formulon does not embed; closure is a divergence-only declaration with each case marked skip-oracle in tests/divergence.yaml.

cases.skipped: IMAGE fetches a network image; Formulon does no network I/O and stubs to #VALUE!. Oracle parity requires an embedded image client.
PY runs Python in the cloud; Formulon does not embed a Python runtime and stubs to #NAME!. Oracle parity requires the Microsoft 365 PY service.
RTD reads from a real-time data COM server; Formulon has no provider runtime and stubs to #N/A. Oracle parity requires a registered COM RTD server.
STOCKHISTORY pulls live market data; Formulon does no network I/O. Oracle parity requires Microsoft 365 stock data subscription.
WEBSERVICE makes an HTTP request; Formulon does no network I/O and stubs to #VALUE!. Oracle parity requires an HTTP client.
COPILOT dispatches to an LLM backend; Formulon does not embed one and stubs to #NAME!. Oracle parity requires the Microsoft 365 Copilot service.
DETECTLANGUAGE calls a translation cloud; Formulon does no network I/O and stubs to #NAME!.
TRANSLATE calls a translation cloud; Formulon does no network I/O and stubs to #NAME!.
ARRAYTOTEXT impl exists but full Excel-format parity (escape rules, locale separators) is unverified; closure deferred to a dedicated suite.
FILTERXML uses pugixml's XPath 1.0; Excel's XPath dialect has minor quirks that may diverge. Closure deferred to a dedicated XPath suite.
INFO returns environment-specific values (locale, version, paths); answers vary by host and are not portable across the oracle harness.
CUBEKPIMEMBER requires a live cube connection; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
CUBEMEMBER requires a live cube connection; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
CUBEMEMBERPROPERTY requires a live cube connection; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
CUBERANKEDMEMBER requires a live cube connection; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
CUBESET requires a live cube connection; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
CUBESETCOUNT requires a live cube set; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
CUBEVALUE requires a live cube connection; Formulon has no OLAP layer and stubs to #NAME!.
GETPIVOTDATA requires a pivot anchor; Formulon has no pivot-table runtime and stubs to #REF!.

PHONETIC reads OOXML rPh annotations; Formulon's OOXML reader does not surface rPh into Value, so unannotated text passes through. Mac without rPh annotations behaves the same on text-cell input but diverges on annotated cells.
